QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Encounter With Lora
QuestInfo.0: You managed to find Lora. But where is #b#p2144004##k?
QuestInfo.2: #p2144004# was injured, but you managed to rescue her.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Starling in Need quest

0.0: That should do it for formalities. This place seems a bit different from the other places we know. I feel a strange energy. Same with the monsters... They've got Sun pretty antsy.\r\n#L0# #bI heard you were coming with Starling. Where is she?#l\n#k
0.1: I, I was looking for Starling also. We both entered the Crack in Time, but she wasn't there when I came out. I'm worried the warp in time did something...\r\n#L0##bWell, then we need to find #p2144004# pronto! She might be in danger!#l\n#k
0.2: Newcomer, help us find Starling. She's a talented Silent Crusader, so she should be okay. I'll look around here. You search elsewhere.

no.0: Take a nice deep breath, and talk to me again when you stop being an enormous coward. We have to find Starling.

1.0:
...!
(You find Starling collapsed on the ground.)
#L0##bStarling! What happened? Are you okay?#l
#k
1.1: #h0#... I'm fine...don't look at me like that. I entered the crack with Lora, but I ended up here, surrounded by those things. I was doing fine, but one of them got a lucky hit on me...not very lucky for me, heh.

yes.0: Whatever the case may be, I'm glad you found me here. Now, I can finally take a breather.

npc.0: I don't see Starling, #h0#. That means you haven't found her, and you have NO reason to be here! Now GO!
